// Dibuat otomatis oleh tools/buat_workflow.py dari sql/etl/01_ekstrak_mysql.sql.
// JANGAN edit query di sini. Ubah file SQL-nya, lalu jalankan ulang generator.
//
// Keluaran: satu item per batch, berisi { tabel, query, offset }.
// Tabel kecil dibaca sekali. Tabel besar dibaca per 5000 baris.

const TABEL_KECIL = {
  "stg_product": "SELECT ProductID                    AS productid,
       Name                         AS name,
       ProductNumber                AS productnumber,
       Color                        AS color,
       ProductSubcategoryID         AS productsubcategoryid,
       CAST(StandardCost AS CHAR)   AS standardcost,
       CAST(ListPrice    AS CHAR)   AS listprice
FROM production_product;",
  "stg_productsubcategory": "SELECT ProductSubcategoryID AS productsubcategoryid,
       ProductCategoryID    AS productcategoryid,
       Name                 AS name
FROM production_productsubcategory;",
  "stg_productcategory": "SELECT ProductCategoryID AS productcategoryid,
       Name              AS name
FROM production_productcategory;",
  "stg_productcosthistory": "SELECT ProductID                                    AS productid,
       DATE_FORMAT(StartDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')  AS startdate,
       DATE_FORMAT(EndDate,   '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')  AS enddate,
       CAST(StandardCost AS CHAR)                   AS standardcost
FROM production_productcosthistory;",
  "stg_productlistpricehistory": "SELECT ProductID                                    AS productid,
       DATE_FORMAT(StartDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')  AS startdate,
       DATE_FORMAT(EndDate,   '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')  AS enddate,
       CAST(ListPrice AS CHAR)                      AS listprice
FROM production_productlistpricehistory;",
  "stg_store": "SELECT BusinessEntityID AS businessentityid,
       Name             AS name,
       SalesPersonID    AS salespersonid,
       Demographics     AS demographics
FROM sales_store;",
  "stg_customer": "SELECT CustomerID  AS customerid,
       PersonID    AS personid,
       StoreID     AS storeid,
       TerritoryID AS territoryid
FROM sales_customer;",
  "stg_salesperson": "SELECT BusinessEntityID             AS businessentityid,
       TerritoryID                  AS territoryid,
       CAST(SalesQuota    AS CHAR)  AS salesquota,
       CAST(Bonus         AS CHAR)  AS bonus,
       CAST(CommissionPct AS CHAR)  AS commissionpct
FROM sales_salesperson;",
  "stg_person": "SELECT BusinessEntityID AS businessentityid,
       FirstName        AS firstname,
       MiddleName       AS middlename,
       LastName         AS lastname
FROM person_person;",
  "stg_salesterritory": "SELECT TerritoryID       AS territoryid,
       Name              AS name,
       CountryRegionCode AS countryregioncode,
       `Group`           AS `group`
FROM sales_salesterritory;",
  "stg_specialoffer": "SELECT SpecialOfferID                               AS specialofferid,
       Description                                  AS description,
       Type                                         AS type,
       Category                                     AS category,
       CAST(DiscountPct AS CHAR)                    AS discountpct,
       DATE_FORMAT(StartDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')  AS startdate,
       DATE_FORMAT(EndDate,   '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')  AS enddate
FROM sales_specialoffer;",
  "stg_shipmethod": "SELECT ShipMethodID           AS shipmethodid,
       Name                   AS name,
       CAST(ShipBase AS CHAR) AS shipbase,
       CAST(ShipRate AS CHAR) AS shiprate
FROM purchasing_shipmethod;",
  "stg_currencyrate": "SELECT CurrencyRateID                                      AS currencyrateid,
       DATE_FORMAT(CurrencyRateDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')  AS currencyratedate,
       FromCurrencyCode                                    AS fromcurrencycode,
       ToCurrencyCode                                      AS tocurrencycode,
       CAST(AverageRate  AS CHAR)                          AS averagerate,
       CAST(EndOfDayRate AS CHAR)                          AS endofdayrate
FROM sales_currencyrate;"
};

const TABEL_BESAR = {
  "stg_salesorderheader": "SELECT SalesOrderID                                       AS salesorderid,
       SalesOrderNumber                                   AS salesordernumber,
       DATE_FORMAT(TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(OrderDate), '1970-01-01 08:00:00'),
                   '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')               AS orderdate,
       DATE_FORMAT(DueDate,   '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')        AS duedate,
       DATE_FORMAT(ShipDate,  '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')        AS shipdate,
       OnlineOrderFlag                                    AS onlineorderflag,
       CustomerID                                         AS customerid,
       SalesPersonID                                      AS salespersonid,
       TerritoryID                                        AS territoryid,
       ShipMethodID                                       AS shipmethodid,
       CurrencyRateID                                     AS currencyrateid,
       CAST(SubTotal AS CHAR)                             AS subtotal,
       CAST(TaxAmt   AS CHAR)                             AS taxamt,
       CAST(Freight  AS CHAR)                             AS freight
FROM sales_salesorderheader
ORDER BY SalesOrderID
LIMIT 5000 OFFSET {{ $json.offset }};",
  "stg_salesorderdetail": "SELECT SalesOrderID                      AS salesorderid,
       SalesOrderDetailID                AS salesorderdetailid,
       ProductID                         AS productid,
       SpecialOfferID                    AS specialofferid,
       OrderQty                          AS orderqty,
       CAST(UnitPrice         AS CHAR)   AS unitprice,
       CAST(UnitPriceDiscount AS CHAR)   AS unitpricediscount,
       CAST(LineTotal         AS CHAR)   AS linetotal
FROM sales_salesorderdetail
ORDER BY SalesOrderDetailID
LIMIT 5000 OFFSET {{ $json.offset }};"
};

const ukuran = 5000;
const jumlah = $input.first().json;   // { stg_salesorderheader: 31465, stg_salesorderdetail: 121317 }
const hasil = [];

for (const [tabel, query] of Object.entries(TABEL_KECIL)) {
  hasil.push({ json: { tabel, query, offset: null } });
}

for (const [tabel, query] of Object.entries(TABEL_BESAR)) {
  // COUNT dari MySQL/MariaDB bisa terbaca sebagai teks, jadi diubah dengan Number().
  const n = Number(jumlah[tabel]);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`Jumlah baris ${tabel} tidak terbaca: ${jumlah[tabel]}`);
  }
  for (let offset = 0; offset < n; offset += ukuran) {
    hasil.push({ json: { tabel, offset, query: query.replace('{{ $json.offset }}', String(offset)) } });
  }
}

return hasil;   // 13 + 7 + 25 = 45 item untuk data Hermes

INSERT INTO dim_produk (produk_id, nama_produk, nomor_produk, warna, subkategori, kategori,
                        biaya_standar, harga_jual, berlaku_mulai, berlaku_sampai, is_current)
SELECT p.productid,
       p.name,
       p.productnumber,
       COALESCE(p.color, 'Tidak ada'),
       COALESCE(ps.name, 'Tanpa kategori'),
       COALESCE(pc.name, 'Tanpa kategori'),
       COALESCE(ch.standardcost, p.standardcost),
       COALESCE(lp.listprice, p.listprice),
       CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.productid ORDER BY ch.startdate) = 1
            THEN DATE '1900-01-01'
            ELSE DATE(ch.startdate)
       END,
       COALESCE(DATE(LEAD(ch.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY p.productid ORDER BY ch.startdate))
                - INTERVAL 1 DAY,
                DATE '9999-12-31'),
       LEAD(ch.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY p.productid ORDER BY ch.startdate) IS NULL
FROM stg_product p
LEFT JOIN stg_productsubcategory ps ON ps.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid
LEFT JOIN stg_productcategory    pc ON pc.productcategoryid    = ps.productcategoryid
LEFT JOIN stg_productcosthistory ch ON ch.productid            = p.productid
LEFT JOIN stg_productlistpricehistory lp
       ON lp.productid  = p.productid
      AND lp.startdate <= ch.startdate
      AND (lp.enddate IS NULL OR lp.enddate >= ch.startdate);

INSERT INTO dim_reseller (reseller_id, nama_reseller, tipe_bisnis,
                          penjualan_tahunan, jumlah_karyawan, tahun_buka)
SELECT x.businessentityid,
       x.name,
       CASE x.kode_bisnis
            WHEN 'BM' THEN 'Value Added Reseller'
            WHEN 'BS' THEN 'Specialty Bike Shop'
            WHEN 'OS' THEN 'Warehouse'
            ELSE COALESCE(x.kode_bisnis, 'Tidak diketahui')
       END,
       COALESCE(CAST(x.penjualan AS DECIMAL(15,2)), 0),
       COALESCE(CAST(x.karyawan  AS SIGNED), 0),
       COALESCE(CAST(x.tahun     AS SIGNED), -1)
FROM (
    SELECT s.businessentityid,
           s.name,
           NULLIF(TRIM(ExtractValue(s.demographics, '//BusinessType')),    '') AS kode_bisnis,
           NULLIF(TRIM(ExtractValue(s.demographics, '//AnnualSales')),     '') AS penjualan,
           NULLIF(TRIM(ExtractValue(s.demographics, '//NumberEmployees')), '') AS karyawan,
           NULLIF(TRIM(ExtractValue(s.demographics, '//YearOpened')),      '') AS tahun
    FROM stg_store s
) x;

INSERT INTO dim_sales_person (sales_person_id, nama_lengkap, komisi_persen, kuota_penjualan)
SELECT sp.businessentityid,
       COALESCE(CONCAT(pe.firstname, ' ', pe.lastname), 'Tidak diketahui'),
       COALESCE(sp.commissionpct, 0),
       COALESCE(sp.salesquota, 0)
FROM stg_salesperson sp
LEFT JOIN stg_person pe ON pe.businessentityid = sp.businessentityid;

INSERT INTO dim_wilayah (wilayah_id, nama_wilayah, kode_negara, grup)
SELECT t.territoryid,
       COALESCE(t.name, 'Tidak diketahui'),
       COALESCE(t.countryregioncode, 'N/A'),
       COALESCE(t.`group`, 'Tidak diketahui')
FROM stg_salesterritory t;

INSERT INTO dim_promosi (promosi_id, deskripsi, jenis, kategori, persentase_diskon, mulai, selesai)
SELECT so.specialofferid,
       COALESCE(so.description, 'Tidak ada promosi'),
       COALESCE(so.type, 'N/A'),
       COALESCE(so.category, 'N/A'),
       COALESCE(so.discountpct, 0),
       COALESCE(DATE(so.startdate), DATE '1900-01-01'),
       COALESCE(DATE(so.enddate),   DATE '9999-12-31')
FROM stg_specialoffer so;

INSERT INTO dim_metode_kirim (metode_kirim_id, nama_metode, biaya_dasar, tarif)
SELECT sm.shipmethodid,
       COALESCE(sm.name, 'Tidak diketahui'),
       COALESCE(sm.shipbase, 0),
       COALESCE(sm.shiprate, 0)
FROM stg_shipmethod sm;

INSERT INTO dim_mata_uang (currency_rate_id, kode_asal, kode_tujuan,
                           tanggal_kurs, average_rate, end_of_day_rate)
VALUES (0, 'USD', 'USD', DATE '1900-01-01', 1, 1);

INSERT INTO dim_mata_uang (currency_rate_id, kode_asal, kode_tujuan,
                           tanggal_kurs, average_rate, end_of_day_rate)
SELECT cr.currencyrateid,
       COALESCE(cr.fromcurrencycode, 'USD'),
       COALESCE(cr.tocurrencycode, 'USD'),
       COALESCE(DATE(cr.currencyratedate), DATE '1900-01-01'),
       COALESCE(cr.averagerate, 1),
       COALESCE(cr.endofdayrate, 1)
FROM stg_currencyrate cr;

INSERT INTO fact_penjualan_reseller (
    tanggal_pesan_key, tanggal_kirim_key, produk_key, reseller_key, sales_person_key,
    wilayah_key, promosi_key, metode_kirim_key, mata_uang_key,
    sales_order_id, sales_order_number,
    jumlah_unit, harga_satuan, nilai_penjualan,
    biaya_standar_produk, harga_jual_standar,
    laba_kotor_reseller, laba_kotor_perusahaan)
SELECT x.tanggal_pesan_key, x.tanggal_kirim_key, x.produk_key, x.reseller_key, x.sales_person_key,
       x.wilayah_key, x.promosi_key, x.metode_kirim_key, x.mata_uang_key,
       x.sales_order_id, x.sales_order_number,
       x.jumlah_unit, x.harga_satuan, x.nilai,
       x.biaya, x.harga_standar,
       x.harga_standar - x.nilai,
       x.nilai - x.biaya
FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(tp.tanggal_key, -1)         AS tanggal_pesan_key,
           COALESCE(tk.tanggal_key, -1)         AS tanggal_kirim_key,
           COALESCE(dp.produk_key, -1)          AS produk_key,
           COALESCE(dr.reseller_key, -1)        AS reseller_key,
           COALESCE(ds.sales_person_key, -1)    AS sales_person_key,
           COALESCE(dw.wilayah_key, -1)         AS wilayah_key,
           COALESCE(dpr.promosi_key, -1)        AS promosi_key,
           COALESCE(dm.metode_kirim_key, -1)    AS metode_kirim_key,
           COALESCE(mu.mata_uang_key, -1)       AS mata_uang_key,
           h.salesorderid                       AS sales_order_id,
           COALESCE(h.salesordernumber, 'N/A')  AS sales_order_number,
           d.orderqty                           AS jumlah_unit,
           d.unitprice                          AS harga_satuan,
           ROUND(d.linetotal, 2)                                AS nilai,
           ROUND(COALESCE(dp.biaya_standar, 0) * d.orderqty, 2) AS biaya,
           ROUND(COALESCE(dp.harga_jual,    0) * d.orderqty, 2) AS harga_standar
    FROM stg_salesorderdetail d
    JOIN stg_salesorderheader h   ON h.salesorderid = d.salesorderid
    LEFT JOIN stg_customer c      ON c.customerid   = h.customerid
    LEFT JOIN dim_tanggal tp      ON tp.tanggal     = DATE(h.orderdate)
    LEFT JOIN dim_tanggal tk      ON tk.tanggal     = DATE(h.shipdate)
    LEFT JOIN dim_produk dp       ON dp.produk_id   = d.productid
                                 AND DATE(h.orderdate) BETWEEN dp.berlaku_mulai AND dp.berlaku_sampai
    LEFT JOIN dim_reseller dr     ON dr.reseller_id      = c.storeid
    LEFT JOIN dim_sales_person ds ON ds.sales_person_id  = h.salespersonid
    LEFT JOIN dim_wilayah dw      ON dw.wilayah_id       = h.territoryid
    LEFT JOIN dim_promosi dpr     ON dpr.promosi_id      = d.specialofferid
    LEFT JOIN dim_metode_kirim dm ON dm.metode_kirim_id  = h.shipmethodid
    LEFT JOIN dim_mata_uang mu    ON mu.currency_rate_id = COALESCE(h.currencyrateid, 0)
    WHERE h.onlineorderflag = 0
) x;
